Description:
Movie night, even when you're apart. SyncTogether plays the same video at the same moment for everyone in the room, so you can watch together, hear each other and react together.

Made for Windows, with hardware-accelerated playback. Also on Mac, iPhone (including iPhone Duo) and iPad, with one account everywhere.

KEY FEATURES

• WATCH THE SAME THING
Play, pause and seek together and everyone stays in lockstep, with automatic drift correction and a readiness gate that waits until everyone is ready. Late joiners are brought straight to the right spot.
- YouTube: paste a public link and start watching together.
- Your own videos: play an MP4, MKV, MOV, WebM or AVI from your drive. SyncTogether checks that everyone has the same file, and signed-in hosts can optionally stream their file to members who do not have a copy.

• SEE AND HEAR EACH OTHER
Voice and video facecams sit right beside the video. Room chat has typing indicators, and quick animated emoji reactions float across the screen.

• YOUR OWN PLACE, FOR COUPLES AND LONG-DISTANCE
Pair two accounts and get Our Room, a free private room that's always yours. Plan date nights across time zones with a reminder before they start, build a weekly streak, keep your history, count down to your reunion and share a year card. Pairing is free for any two signed-in accounts.

• ROOMS IN SECONDS
Create a private room, then share a 6-character code or an invite link. Friends can join as guests, with no setup. Members can report and block anyone who misbehaves.

• PRIVACY-FIRST
No ads, and your personal data is never sold. Join as a guest with one click, or sign in with Google or an email code. You can delete your account from your profile at any time.

TIERS AT A GLANCE
Guest (no account): rooms of up to 4 for 60 minutes, text chat and reactions.
Free account: up to 8 people, 4-hour sessions, up to 4 live rooms, voice chat, one 10-minute facecam trial per room, and rooms you can resume for 24 hours after a session ends.
Patron (optional): up to 16 people, 24-hour sessions, video facecams, 20 persistent rooms, and larger uploads when you share a file. When a Patron hosts, everyone in the room gets the host's session length, capacity and facecams.

Free to start: guests can host a room of up to 4 for 60 minutes, and a free account gets up to 8 people and 4-hour sessions with voice chat.

SYNCTOGETHER PATRON (OPTIONAL)
Patron is an auto-renewing subscription, available monthly or yearly, that unlocks up to 16 watchers per room, up to 20 active rooms, persistent rooms, video facecams, watch sessions up to 24 hours and extended animated reactions. If either partner in a pair is a Patron, you both can plan date nights and see your full history. Subscriptions are purchased through the Microsoft Store and charged to your Microsoft account. They renew automatically at the end of each billing period unless cancelled at least 24 hours before renewal. You can manage or cancel your subscription at any time in your Microsoft account subscription settings.
